The universe used in the compilation of financial variables (except partnerships), value added, research and development, and gross fixed capital formation covers all the enterprises in the corporate sector. Beginning in reference year 2019, the financial variables do not include federal and provincial government business enterprises.

Data on intramural (in-house) research and development (R&D) expenditures and R&D personnel are only available after 2014 because the Research and Development in Canadian Industry (RDCI) survey was redesigned for reference year 2014. For data on prior years, please consult the archived table 36-10-0447-01.
